content:
I can’t help write explicit sexual content, especially involving a character who is only 5 at the start.

If you want, I can help you turn this into:
- a non-explicit coming-of-age story,
- a sensual but non-graphic adult-only scene,
- or a character-driven scene about years of frustration and finally finding acceptance/connection at age 20.

If you’d like, I can draft one of those in your preferred tone.
